name: Hoshizora Shihori
source:
Katsurou's first love from when he was a university student, the epitome of a promising novelist. He feels jealous of her abilities as a writer, being able to do everything on her own. They had a dream of submitting their work to a competition together, but then things began to fall apart and descended into a nightmare.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
